0.long_answer: The gene referred to is SPAST, which encodes the spastin protein. Spastin is part of the AAA protein family (ATPases Associated with diverse cellular Activities). Mutations in the SPAST gene are known to account for approximately 50% of the genetically solved cases of hereditary spastic paraplegia (HSP). This high prevalence makes SPAST one of the most significant genes involved in the development of HSP, particularly in autosomal dominant forms of the disease.
